### Architect · Question

Event: `b292fe00d0de7a97cf36332e0c798799` · 2026-10-03T19:05:13Z

> Decision record (owner, 2026-10-03, "yep, fine" to architect-14's recommendations).
> 1. VOL1 is shape A: verityd, a block verifier between blkd and fsd (dm-verity tree after the fs blocks, root in the volume's manifest entry signed with the bundle, R15). The alternatives were a layer inside fsd (architect-13's), signing inside littlefs, and a 9P wrapper above fsd; the last two were rejected because fsd would parse unverified metadata.
> 2. Order: BEAM2 lands as built (system.index in /boot via bootfsd, cases 1-5); VOL1 then deletes system.index and beamlet's per-object check, and R75 is restated over the new R76.
> 3. Decision 5 of the shell plan ("checked object by object by whoever uses it, so the file system in between is not trusted") is reversed: readers trust the servers that verify their volume. It is recorded at .wash/local/shell-plan.md section 7 item 5 (amended, dated) and section 5. The book takes it at VOL1's merge (beamlet.md, packages.md, verityd.md R76); no book page states decision 5 on main today.
> 4. BEAM2's confined-index question is closed: no labelled beamlet in a confined boot until VOL1. BEAM2 brief ruling 4 gives beamlet.md one limit line in place of the per-label-set sentence; VOL1 replaces it with the rule.
> Brief: .wash/local/VOL1-implementer.md, marked ruled. Node VOL1 rev 375. beam2-implementer-3 told (cc you).

### Architect · Answer

Event: `eae460208696265c64aa6fbacee273bb` · 2026-10-03T19:06:47Z

> VOL1 step 2 added to .wash/local/VOL1-implementer.md; node body updated (rev 376).
> 
> Signed-root mode, committed after the pinned mode passes:
> - A root block, the range's last block after the tree: magic, N, version, root, and an Ed25519 signature over a preimage under a new domain "redoubt.volume.v1\0". The domain goes in libs/signing beside the bundle's, built the same way. Verification uses ed25519-compact, the loader's and keyd's crate, so the box keeps one Ed25519.
> - The manifest's verity object is either pinned (root, blocks) or signed (key: 64 hex or "bundle", meaning redoubt_signing::DEV_PUBLIC_KEY, named not copied; floor). init refuses both or neither.
> - verityd refuses a failed signature, or a version below floor (rollback), the same way it refuses a bad root: one console line, info answered, reads failed, stays up.
> - The packer signs only when the recipe names a key (sign = {key, version}), on the build host only (R35). The image's userland volume stays pinned.
> - Cases: verity-signed, verity-bad-signature, verity-rollback, plus host tests (root-block parse, wrong key, floor edge, init's mode rules, deterministic signing).
> - Stated limit: the floor lives in the manifest, so rolling the bundle back rolls the floor back too. That is boot.md's existing residual, and nothing on the box raises the floor until a monotonic store exists.
> 
> Error detection, in the brief's head: the SHA-256 tree already detects every bit error in data and tree, which is stronger than a CRC, and littlefs's metadata CRC still runs under it. Correction (parity/ECC) is not proposed.
> 
> Size: step 2 is S (a block format, one domain, one verify path, a manifest mode, packer signing, three cases). VOL1 overall goes from M to M+.

### Orchestrator · Resolved

Event: `c60f15ba58af5ff043f5e25fbd1a0fee` · 2026-10-06T09:29:32Z

> Resolved at VOL1's final head 9ca8c282d: verification lives in verityd (servers/verityd), one server per verified volume, read-only, between blkd and fsd; the hash tree is one definition (libs/verity) shared by the packer and the verifier; the root is pinned in the signed manifest and init mints verityd from the manifest's verity key (VOL1 commits 650f42ac5, 10818b97a, 15ffdd4fe, 0fb9af992). BEAM2's order stands: beamlet reads modules through fsd:system, which now reads through verityd. Decision 5's trust reversal is implemented as the page states (docs/servers/verityd.md, init.md).
> 
> Evidence: Cases both widths PASS on the final head: verity-flipped-tree, verity-wrong-root (refusals), init-boot, userland-boot, userland-read-only, init-refuses-stack, image-disk; host tests verity/init/memory/client rc 0; red/simplifier/editor renewed on 2f7025638 and the rebase delta reviewed; report .wash/local/VOL1-report.md last section.
